title: Petlibro’s new AI-powered feeder is a game changer for multi-cat homes
slides: Can Petlibro's new AI feeder end multi-cat feeding wars?
It uses AI to identify each cat by its microchip or face.
But cats learn to outsmart it in surprising ways.
You can now schedule individual meals for each cat.
Test it for a week to see if tensions ease.
thread_text:
1. The real multi-cat problem

Petlibro's new AI feeder claims to end mealtime chaos by identifying each cat and serving individual portions, but the real test is whether it survives feline ingenuity.

2. Microchip or face scan

The feeder uses microchip or facial recognition to tell cats apart. It schedules meals per cat, but cats quickly learn to game the system by blocking sensors or swapping positions.

3. Cats outsmart the AI

In tests, cats triggered false readings by sitting on the feeder or pawing at the camera. Some even learned to wait for another cat's portion to drop, defeating the purpose.

4. Scheduling individual meals

You can now set exact portions and times for each cat via an app. That means no more guarding bowls or separating cats at mealtime—if the AI works as promised.

5. Test it for a week

Try it for seven days and watch if tensions actually drop. Does it save time, or just add another gadget to outsmart? Share your results.
